title: Loving Your Neighbor
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Loving your neighbor means seeking another person’s good according to God’s truth and mercy. Love for God is displayed through practical, sacrificial, truthful love toward others.
summary: Loving your neighbor means seeking another person’s good according to God’s truth and mercy. Love for God is displayed through practical, sacrificial, truthful love toward others.
christFocus: Jesus Christ perfectly fulfills the command to love and teaches His people to love as He has loved them. His compassion, sacrifice, truth, and mercy shape Christian love for neighbor.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus teaches that love for God and love for neighbor summarize the heart of God’s commands. Neighbor love is not optional decoration on the Christian life; it is central to faithful obedience.

The parable of the good Samaritan shows that neighbor love moves toward need with mercy. It crosses convenience, prejudice, fear, and self-protection to serve another person with compassion.

Biblical love is not sentimental approval of everything. It seeks true good according to God’s Word. Love serves, speaks truth, shows mercy, protects, gives, forgives, and acts for the good of others.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
It is possible to know doctrine and still fail to love people. Scripture will not let believers separate love for God from love for neighbor.

This doctrine pushes discipleship into daily life. The neighbor is not an abstract idea, but the person God places before us in need, weakness, inconvenience, or difference.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God to show you the neighbor in front of you. Love practically, not merely in words. Serve the overlooked, speak truth with humility, show mercy, and refuse to use doctrine as an excuse for coldness toward people Christ calls you to love.
